name: ExtractTextFromPdfNode
label: Extract Text from Pdf
description: Extracts text or images from a Pdf file based on selection.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: SourcePdfPath
fields.label: Pdf File
fields.description: The path to the source Pdf file.

fields.name: PageSelection
fields.label: Page Selection Mode
fields.description: Select how to choose pages for extraction: All, Single, or Range.

selectOptions.label: All
selectOptions.description: Extract text and images from all pages.

selectOptions.label: Single
selectOptions.description: Extract text and images from a single page.

selectOptions.label: Range
selectOptions.description: Extract text and images from a range of pages.

fields.name: ExtractionType
fields.label: Extraction Type
fields.description: Select the type of extraction: Text, Images, or Both.

selectOptions.label: Text
selectOptions.description: Extract only text from the Pdf.

selectOptions.label: Images
selectOptions.description: Extract only images from the Pdf.

selectOptions.label: Both
selectOptions.description: Extract both text and images from the Pdf.

fields.name: PageNumber
fields.label: Page Number (for Single)
fields.description: The specific page number to extract from. Only used if Page Selection is set to Single.

fields.name: FromPageNumber
fields.label: From Page Number (for Range)
fields.description: The starting page number for extraction. Only used if Page Selection is set to Range.

fields.name: ToPageNumber
fields.label: To Page Number (for Range)
fields.description: The ending page number for extraction. Only used if Page Selection is set to Range.

fields.name: Password
fields.label: Password
fields.description: Optional password for encrypted Pdf files. Leave empty if not required.

fields.name: OutputFolderPath
fields.label: Output Folder Path
fields.description: The folder where extracted images will be saved.

fields.name: ExtractedText
fields.label: Extracted Text
fields.description: Returns the extracted text from the Pdf.
